Definition: to sever, i.e. ransom; gener. to release, preserve
BiblicalUsage: 1) to ransom, redeem, rescue, deliver; 1a) (Qal) to ransom; 1b) (Niphal) to be ransomed; 1c) (Hiphil) to allow one to be ransomed; 1d) (Hophal) redeemed
